nodes.interes.options.#0.text.t: At least the horses are grateful.

nodes.interes.text.t: "Like an ox going uphill. Everyone wants a horse shod, nobody wants to pay. The Emperor takes his tax, but he couldn't forge a horseshoe to save his life."

nodes.kamien_po.text.t: "A stone's a stone, only not of this earth. I won't forge it, and I don't want to know where it came from, devil knows. Keep it away from iron and away from people. Both spell trouble."

nodes.kuznia.options.[odlamek_pokaz].tex.t: A mill shard, but no job.

nodes.kuznia.text.t: The smith works the coals with his bellows. "Horseshoes, hooks, nails. I don't forge spells, nobody pays for those. What've you got?"

nodes.odlamek.text.t: Zbych grabs the shard with his tongs, holds it in the coals and watches it neither melt nor blacken. "That's no glass. That's a stone from the sky, like the ones left in folk's skulls after a spark storm. Keep it away from iron and don't tell anyone you had it from me."

nodes.odlamek_pokaz.text.t: Zbych grabs the shard with his tongs, holds it in the coals and watches it neither melt nor blacken. "That's no glass, that's a stone from the sky. Take it, it's not mine. You'll find a job on the board yourself, if you need coin. And don't tell anyone you had it from me." He spits into the coals.

nodes.ostoja_plotka.text.t: "Brigands? Every other day someone comes in here moaning about brigands. But the ones at the Roost are a different breed. Three days east, where the forest gets so thick even a wolf would lose his way. Their chief sits there drinking from other men's cups. Go, if you're tired of living."

nodes.proch.text.t: "Powder? Not my trade. I forge, I don't shoot." The smith juts his beard toward the alley behind the tavern. "Szkarad, the gunsmith. Black with soot and chatty as a tree stump. You'll find crossbows there, and those devil's pipes from the island. Say Zbych sent you, and he won't throw you out straight away."

nodes.towar.text.t: Zbych wipes his hands on his apron and opens a chest by the wall. "Iron for every purse. Well, nearly every one. Look all you like, but don't drool on my steel."
